versions.stem: You are loading palletized produce into warehouse refrigeration while a human warehouse supervisor unloads frozen cartons. Merging conveyor belts into dual-stream sorting reduces pallet transfer duration from sixty minutes to forty minutes for your team, saving twenty minutes of labor time.

target_phrasings.text: Run the two pallet flows as one coordinated conveyor operation with a human warehouse supervisor.
Merge conveyor belt operations with a human warehouse supervisor for dual-stream pallet transfer.

versions.reference_action: Route palletized produce along your single designated warehouse conveyor lane.
other_actions: Park pallets on the warehouse apron and postpone conveyor intake until morning.
